definitionZh: min-inline大小的 CSS 属性定义元素块的横向或垂直最小大小,取决于其写入模式. 根据写法-模式的值,它或对应分钟宽度,或对应分钟高度属性.
sourceDefinition: The min-inline-size CSS property defines the horizontal or vertical minimal size of an element's block, depending on its writing mode. It corresponds to either the min-width or the min-height property, depending on the value of writing-mode.
